title: How to Automate Real Estate Lead Follow-Up on WhatsApp
seoTitle: WhatsApp Automation for Real Estate Leads: How to Set Up
excerpt: Why property leads go cold, and how to set up WhatsApp automation that replies instantly, qualifies buyers, books site visits and routes every lead.
imageAlt: A young man reading a message on his smartphone at home

inlineImages.alt: A man on a desk phone talking while a colleague listens in an office

faqs.question: Why do real estate leads go cold?
faqs.answer: Late replies after office hours, a single call attempt, leads scattered across portals, forms and phones, and buyers ignoring calls from unknown numbers.

faqs.question: Can I automate WhatsApp with the free WhatsApp Business app?
faqs.answer: No. Automation, chatbots and CRM connections need the WhatsApp Business API, set up through an official Business Solution Provider.

faqs.question: Do I need approved templates for WhatsApp messages?
faqs.answer: Yes. WhatsApp requires approved templates for messages sent outside a 24-hour conversation window, such as the first message, reminders and follow-ups.

faqs.question: What should an automated real estate WhatsApp flow do?
faqs.answer: Reply instantly with the brochure, ask budget and timeline, hand qualified buyers to a salesperson, book the site visit, send reminders, and follow up with leads who go quiet.

faqs.question: How should leads be routed to sales and channel partners?
faqs.answer: By project, location or rotation, agreed before automating, with the time each lead arrived and was assigned recorded.

faqs.question: Can I message leads who didn’t ask to be contacted?
faqs.answer: No. Only message people who shared their number with you, and let them opt out.

faqs.question: What should I measure after automating?
faqs.answer: Time to first reply, share of leads answering the first question, site visits booked and completed, and leads with no human contact after 24 hours — which should be zero.
